plan.runs: Per case: renderer WAV+report; instrument report+profile; instrument no-report+profile. Release feature profile-alloc. No audio device or instrument audio writing.

limits: Six-second hold/flow screen at 4/16/64 Voices with both buses, not the 60-second warmup plus 600-second formal preflight or a live device test. The instrument wrote profiles/reports only; WAVs came from conchordal-render.

All measured resource times are wall time, not thread CPU time. Private frame cost includes parsing, NSGT, descriptor/prototype work and publication lock/copy; it excludes meter update, buffer return and completion notification. Startup covers worker lane initialization, not caller-side PCM pool allocation.

Resource histograms cover the whole run including partial EOF; complete_windows excludes incomplete delivery windows. P99 is a nearest-rank interval from bounded histogram bins, not an exact interpolated value or a warmup-selected distribution. Each private meter has 66 total and 65 complete windows.

Private 64-Voice hold and flow p99 intervals are (50,75] ms per 100ms window for report on and off. These fail the 40ms wall-time screen. Counts above 50ms are hold 24/27 and flow 25/33 for report/no-report. This is not a direct CPU-time acceptance result.

Whole-hop wall p99 includes deterministic private-worker completion waits. Both 64-Voice scenarios exceed 8.533333ms with report on and off. These offline wall measurements do not establish live device performance.

A single private delivery above25ms occurred in hold4 no-report and flow4 report. Shared-worker all-window maxima remain below16ms for this limited, at-most-three-prototype input; no full-eight-prototype or queue/freshness acceptance follows.

Private table/rejected meter fields have no independent table/rejection workload. Null meters mean disabled or unavailable, never zero cost. Candidate counters and maximum processing time do not measure candidate queue, consume age or combined per-hop decision cost.

Physical prototype transfer validity, non-energy consequences, full conditional default and the remaining normal integrations are incomplete. R2/full resources and A3/device acceptance remain separate. I10 incomplete; I9 held; I11 disabled; evaluation-time defaults unchanged.
